cards.title: Bringing work back
cards.body: To bring a branch's commits into `main`, switch to `main`, then run `git merge <branch>`.
cards.code:
git init
touch index.html
git add .
git commit -m "Start"
git switch -c footer
touch footer.html
git add .
git commit -m "Add footer"
git switch main
git merge footer
ls

hi.title: Kaam wapas laana
hi.body: Branch ke commits `main` mein laane ke liye `main` par switch karo, phir `git merge <branch>` chalao.

cards.title: Fast-forward
cards.body: If `main` hasn't moved since the branch started, Git simply moves `main` forward to the branch's latest commit. That is a fast-forward.

hi.title: Fast-forward
hi.body: Agar branch shuru hone ke baad `main` aage nahi badha, toh Git bas `main` ko branch ke latest commit tak aage le jaata hai. Ise fast-forward kehte hain.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The merge says `Already up to date.` and `main` never gets the footer. Which line is wrong?
cards.code:
git init
touch index.html
git add .
git commit -m "Start"
git switch -c footer
touch footer.html
git add .
git commit -m "Add footer"
git merge footer

bug.fix: You are still on `footer`, so this merges `footer` into itself. Run `git switch main` first, then `git merge footer`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Merge kehta hai `Already up to date.` aur `main` ko footer kabhi nahi milta. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: Aap abhi bhi `footer` par ho, isliye yeh `footer` ko khud mein hi merge karta hai. Pehle `git switch main` chalao, phir `git merge footer`.

check.question: You are on `footer` and want its work in `main`. What do you run first?
check.explanation: Merging brings work INTO the branch you are on, so go to `main` first.

hi.question: Aap `footer` par ho aur uska kaam `main` mein chahiye. Pehle kya chalaoge?
hi.explanation: Merge kaam ko usi branch MEIN laata hai jahan aap ho, isliye pehle `main` par jao.

exercise.prompt: The `footer` branch has a finished footer. Merge it into `main`.
exercise.promptHi: `footer` branch mein footer tayyar hai. Use `main` mein merge karo.
